fields.zone: The physical area or department where the record applies.
fields.role: The job title or personnel classification.
fields.authorisation: Whether a specific role is authorized for access or action.
fields.station: The specific equipment or workstation identifier.
fields.rule: The narrative statement of a technical or operational rule.
fields.asset: The physical equipment or hardware entity.
fields.sensor: The identifier of the measurement sensor.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the sensor values.
fields.nominal: The target or normal operating value range.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required corrective or maintenance action.
fields.depends_on: The upstream asset or system that the record depends on.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of a fault on subsequent systems or processes.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that initiates a response.
fields.priority: The criticality or priority level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in a zone.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced or monitored.
fields.type: The classification of the anomaly or event.
fields.definition: The technical description of what constitutes a specific anomaly type.
fields.detection_criterion: The mathematical or logical logic used to detect an anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal system classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.requirement: The mandatory operational or security requirement.
fields.pattern: The causal sequence of events across different assets.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause or primary failure mode.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of a primary fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to resolve the issue.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.fault_propagation: The logic of how faults move through the system.
fields.criterion: The guiding principle or standard for a decision.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.

categories.AccessConstraint: Rules regarding personnel access and authorization.
categories.StaticLimit: Fixed threshold values and nominal ranges.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions taken in response to specific triggers.
categories.AnomalyDefinition: Definitions and detection logic for anomalies.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: Rules on how faults spread through the system.
